source: Issue #553, @travel-and-cache, 2026-10-14: two PowerOcean 241/3 frames from the reporter's write-up, one header each. The wallbox serial in the accessory descriptor (pdata field 1.2, masked as 16 x 'X' by the integration) is replaced by the test dummy C376TEST00000007 of the same length; the envelope's own serial (header field 24) stays masked. Nothing else is changed.
